newsitem.title: THAILAND: BOT says deposit runs on 10 finance firms ease.
newsitem.headline: BOT says deposit runs on 10 finance firms ease.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand said on Wednesday that deposit runs on 10 finance companies which had been instructed to raise capital had eased sharply from levels in early March.

The central bank said in a statement the 10 firms had net combined fund withdrawals of 2.2 billion baht ($84.6 million) during the week ending March 21 against 5.8 billion a week earlier and 17.4 billion in early March.

The central bank announced on March 3 that it ordered the 10 cash-strapped companies to raise capital to assure creditors that they could continue operating soundly. It said a central bank-operated fund would step in to inject liquidity into the firms if necessary.
The announcement triggered the initial deposit runs by the public.

The finance firms, including International Trust and Finance Plc, Sri Dhana Finance and Securities Plc and Dynamic Eastern Finance Thailand (1991) Plc, were among financial institutions weakened by over-exposure to Thailand's ailing property sector.

The bank said on Wednesday that market sentiment in the 10 firms has gradually improved. It said the companies obtained combined new deposits of 723.9 million baht on March 21 against total withdrawals of 309.7 million.
